config.sqlTemplate: SELECT sum(ending_concurrency) AS concurrent_now FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE $__filters AND bucket_start = (SELECT max(bucket_start) FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime))
SELECT max(bucket_peak) AS exact_peak FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_total WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime)
SELECT round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters
SELECT dateDiff('second', max(watermark_ts), now64(3)) AS lag_seconds FROM __DATABASE__.serving_watermark FINAL WHERE layer = 'live'

SELECT $__timeInterval(bucket_start) AS ts, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(bucket_start) AS ts, max(bucket_peak) AS peak, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS time_weighted_average FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_total WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(bucket_start) AS ts, title, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters AND content_id IN (SELECT content_id FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY content_id ORDER BY sum(active_ms) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY ts, title ORDER BY ts

SELECT title, video_type, category, max(bucket_peak) AS exact_peak, argMax(ending_concurrency, bucket_start) AS now, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours FROM __DATABASE__.serving_live_content WHERE ($__timeFilter(bucket_start) AND bucket_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY title, video_type, category ORDER BY max(bucket_peak) DESC LIMIT 25

config.markdown:
**Live layer** · `serving_concurrency_live` · 10-second grain · rebuilt every 10s over a 30-minute trailing window · 3-day retention.

Best-effort: publishes without waiting for late events, so a late arrival can revise a published bucket. Buckets older than the rebuild window are frozen and slightly optimistic — measured 0.066% high. Corrected figures are on *Concurrency analytics*.

**Active** = started, not ended, foreground, playing, and a liveness signal within 120s. Foreground and playing are independent: 13,382 of 14,256 `AppForegrounded` events leave playback stopped. Policy `sonyliv-active-v1`, half-open `[start, end)`, UTC.

Tiles built on `active_ms` or `ending_concurrency` follow the filters and stay exact — both are additive. Tiles marked *ungrouped* read rows that carry no content dimension and cannot be filtered.
